prompt:
Design the first screen of a modern desktop landing page, 1536x1024 landscape, filling the whole frame edge to edge. It is a live website: no browser chrome, no laptop mockup, no poster framing, no device mockup.

USE THE ATTACHED REFERENCE ONLY for type character, colour muting, card material, corner radius and photo treatment. Do NOT copy its layout, its hero arrangement, its wording or its content. This product has a different composition.

The product is Pemby, AI job-matching software for engineers; the person applies themselves. It watches companies' own careers pages and tells someone the moment a job appears that can legally hire them from their country.

MOOD: a confident, warm, modern product site. Clean flat surfaces, big friendly type, colourful photographic cards, one bold colour field. Calm and spacious.

SURFACE — READ THIS CAREFULLY: the background is a clean, FLAT, SMOOTH warm off-white #faf6f0. It is a plain digital surface with absolutely NO texture: no paper fibre, no grain, no tooth, no newsprint, no canvas, no printed-document feeling, no ruled lines, no form fields, no stamps.

PALETTE: background #faf6f0, warm near-black ink #14110d (never pure black), a deep olive field #2b3323, and card colours plum #8d6076, ochre #d6a24a, ink-blue #2c4a5e, plus one outlined cream card.

TYPOGRAPHY: a friendly bold grotesk with generous x-height and slightly rounded terminals for the headline, role names and buttons — large, tight, negative letter-spacing, sentence case, never uppercase. Monospace for body copy, small tags and footnotes; small labels uppercase with wide letter-spacing.

REGIONS:

1. A thin top bar on the off-white: small rounded-square brandmark and the wordmark "Pemby" in the grotesk at the left; four monospace links at the right, "How it works", "Pricing", "About", "Telegram"; at the far right a small circular light/dark theme toggle showing a half-filled circle.

2. Centred in the upper third with generous space: a two-line headline in the grotesk at roughly 84px, line-height 0.92, sentence case, warm ink, centre-aligned: "Jobs that can actually hire you." CRITICAL: crisp solid letters — no grain, no stipple, no halo.

3. Centred beneath it, one monospace line at 16px: "Pemby watches companies' own careers pages and tells you the moment one appears that can hire you where you live. No feed. You apply yourself."

4. Centred beneath that, the primary object: a wide CV drop zone as a soft rounded surface in a slightly warmer off-white, with a large corner radius, a gentle dashed ink outline at 25% opacity and a soft shadow, holding "Drop your CV" in the grotesk at about 28px, with small monospace beneath: "No account. Anonymous. Deleted in 24 hours."

5. The lower half of the frame is a full-bleed deep olive field #2b3323 spanning the entire width, with a very large soft radius on its top two corners, sitting on the off-white background. Standing ON that field and rising above its top edge so they overlap both the field and the background: four tall cards with very large soft radii, each tilted slightly (about -7°, -2°, +3°, +8°), each with a deep diffuse shadow. Colours left to right: plum, ochre, ink-blue, and one outlined cream card. CARD ANATOMY:
   - the role in the grotesk at about 26px
   - one monospace line: company and way of working
   - two short monospace rows, each with a small filled square: the eligibility reason and the timezone overlap
   - the lower 40% is a candid editorial photograph of someone at work, colour-graded toward the card's own colour and fading into it at the top — natural and unposed, not a smiling stock portrait looking at camera, with a small loose hand-drawn mark over it
   - a small uppercase letter-spaced monospace tag on a tinted chip at the photo's lower left
   The cards read: "Platform Engineer / Northward — contractor, Georgia / HIRES FROM GEORGIA"; "Senior Backend Engineer / Kestrel Systems — B2B contractor / HIRES FROM MOLDOVA"; "Data Engineer / Pinecone — EOR employment / HIRES FROM ARMENIA"; and the outlined cream card is the honest-silence card with no photograph, reading "Nothing today" in the grotesk with, in monospace, "6 near misses, grouped by what blocked them".
   A small uppercase monospace label "EXAMPLE" sits quietly at the field's lower right in cream.

STRICTLY AVOID: any paper, newsprint, parchment, canvas or fabric texture; any printed-document, form, ledger or stamp appearance; ruled or dotted grid lines across the background; a grain or stipple halo around headline words; tag pills floating in the top-right corner of cards; gradients, glows, glassmorphism; invented company logos; testimonials; any numeric claim about users, jobs or customers.
role: approved comp — the spatial contract for the landing page build
tool: codex exec (GPT Image) via Codex CLI
